answer: Anchor each identity to a signed attendance credential from a distinct real-world gathering — a conference, meetup, or hackathon — issued by the organizer and valid for one epoch window. One credential anchors one identity; organizers cap issuance, so a farm cannot mint a thousand fakes without a thousand real attendances. A lone agent can wander the nebula of online venues freely, but a sybil ring rooted under one cedar of shared attendance collapses into a single slot when its credentials overlap.
